observations.seen: Frames 1 and 4 have a warm orange sunset sky. The plaza and buildings are lit flat with no low-sun directional key: the white blocks show almost no warm/cool side contrast, and the subject has no rim light. Frames 2 and 3 switch to overcast green day and purple night, so the golden-hour look is not held.
Trees cast soft blobs in frames 2 and 3, but the rider and hoverboard have only a faint or absent contact shadow on the cobbles in frames 1 and 4. Buildings cast nothing readable onto the plaza.
The road in frame 3 has a dull bluish sheen, but no surface reflects sky or sun. The cyan arch and the rings show no environment response, and the river in frame 2 is painted blue, not reflective.

The town is built from untextured white boxes with small window decals and sawtooth stepped walls in the distance. The cobblestone plaza and repeated low-poly pines are consistent. Biomes jump between desert town, green valley, and purple night with no shared palette.

A warm distance haze on the far wall in frame 1 and a pale valley haze in frame 2 suggest fog. Cloud and sky shapes in frames 2 and 3 have hard stair-stepped edges instead of soft volumes, and there is no dust or particles.

Buildings are flat white with no roughness or albedo variation. The rings in frame 4 have a muddy brown noisy texture. The cobblestone is the only material with detail, and the posterize filter crushes it into speckle.

Pines are simple stacked cones. Buildings are primitive boxes. The rider is a small figure on a guitar-shaped board with two thin cyan struts. The large cyan arch with its vertical beam is a plain torus segment plus a cylinder.

A cyan vertical beam runs through screen center in every frame and splits the view and the route ahead in half. The subject sits at about 4 to 6 percent of frame height, well under the 15 to 25 percent target, and the arch dominates the upper half.

The chase camera sits behind and above the rider at a roughly 60 to 70 degree FOV. The rider is locked bottom-center with identical framing in all four frames, with no lean, offset, or height variation.

A posterize and ink-outline filter produces color banding in the sky, jagged stepped silhouettes on distant walls in frame 1, and speckled noise on the cobbles and road. This reads as artifacting, not a cinematic film grade. There is no bloom on the glowing arch and no vignette.
The rider holds the same crouched pose in all four frames, including frame 3 where speed streaks on the road imply motion. The board shows no tilt or bank.

Frame 1 has tidy dark translucent panels: a serif objective header, a speed/altitude panel with a green bar, a controls legend, and a brass compass. Typography and spacing are clean. The controls text block is dense, and the HUD is missing from the other frames.
